description: Automatically import GDB table layer data to PostgreSQL database

datasource_selector.info: Select target PostgreSQL datasource (dynamically loaded from data-construction service)

database_selector.info: Select target database (loaded from selected PostgreSQL datasource)

file_id_variable.info: Use file ID from variable (e.g., {gdbFileId}). Has higher priority than file selection.

create_table.info: Automatically create table if it doesn't exist (default: Yes)

truncate_first.info: Clear existing data before importing (default: No)

batch_size.info: Number of rows to write per batch (default: 1000)

warnings.no_table_layers: No table-type layers found in GDB file

errors.no_file: No GDB file selected. Please provide either a file or file ID variable.
errors.no_datasource: No PostgreSQL datasource selected. Please select a datasource or connect from GDB Create component.
errors.no_minio_url: No MinIO URL found for file ID {file_id}
errors.get_url_failed: Failed to get URL for file {file_id}: {error}
